title: Zimri's Conspiracy and Death
description: Zimri, commander of half the chariots, killed King Elah while he was getting drunk in Tirzah and wiped out the entire house of Baasha, just as the Lord had spoken through the prophet Jehu. But Zimri reigned for only seven days before the army proclaimed Omri king. When Omri besieged Tirzah, Zimri went into the citadel of the royal palace and set fire to it over himself, dying in the flames.
